mapper.sql: w.WRITE_OFF_ID, w.WRITE_OFF_NO, w.RECEIVABLE_ID, w.CUSTOMER_ID, w.WRITE_OFF_AMOUNT, w.WRITE_OFF_REASON, w.WRITE_OFF_DATE, w.WRITE_OFF_STATUS, w.AUDIT_TIME, w.AUDITOR_ID, w.AUDIT_COMMENTS, w.TENANT_ID, w.ORG_ID, w.CREATE_TIME, w.CREATE_BY, w.UPDATE_TIME, w.UPDATE_BY, w.IS_DELETED
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TBL_AR_BAD_DEBT_WRITE_OFF w WHERE w.IS_DELETED = 0 AND w.RECEIVABLE_ID = #{receivableId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_AR_BAD_DEBT_WRITE_OFF SET WRITE_OFF_STATUS = #{status}, AUDIT_TIME = SYSDATE, AUDITOR_ID = #{auditorId}, AUDIT_COMMENTS = #{auditComments}, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE WRITE_OFF_ID = #{writeOffId}
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(1) as writeOffCount, NVL(SUM(WRITE_OFF_AMOUNT), 0) as totalWriteOffAmount FROM TBL_AR_BAD_DEBT_WRITE_OFF WHERE IS_DELETED = 0
AND TENANT_ID = #{param.tenantId}

SELECT #{prefix} || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') || LPAD(NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(WRITE_OFF_NO, -4))), 0) + 1, 4, '0') FROM TBL_AR_BAD_DEBT_WRITE_OFF WHERE TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND WRITE_OFF_NO LIKE #{prefix} || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') || '%'
